svg.title: leereilly/star-chart
svg.desc: Star history for leereilly/star-chart over 1 year. 2,048 current stars. 879 recorded additions in range. 2025-09-14 to 2026-09-06. Scale: absolute. Display intervals subdivide nominal API weeks; the final week may still be partial. Column height rounds up to whole tiles. Legend ranges exclude the lower bound and include the upper bound; unoccupied tiles are above the column height.
